memory.content: The interactive AI story series keeps the same cast and set every episode (same recurring characters, same voices, and same house/rooms), changing only the situation, modeled on viral AI character pages.

The interactive story Shorts are one continuous, movie-like story with a real plot and twist, consistent characters in every episode, and trending topics woven in, built so that whichever option viewers vote for, the story stays fun and neither choice is a dud.

The interactive story series takes votes both in social comments (A/B replies) and on the brand's vote page, showing two vote buttons, live totals, and a countdown; on TikTok and YouTube Shorts, captions point viewers to the link in bio since caption links aren't clickable.
Each episode posts at 7 PM local time with a ~23-hour voting window (closing around 6 PM the next day) so comment and web votes can be tallied and the winning continuation posted on time.

# Interactive AI Story Series Studio

Produce a continuous, episodic AI-animated short-form video series where the cast and set stay locked every episode and viewers vote on A/B choices to decide the next episode.

## 1. Lock the Series Bible (`/workspace/story_series/series_bible_LOCKED.md`)
- Keep the **same recurring cast** (hero, mascot/sidekick, recurring foil or AI character) and **same home set/rooms** across every episode so viewers immediately recognize the world.
- Lock each character's visual description, reference images (`refs_locked/`), and voice profile so only the situation changes from episode to episode.
- Never alter a signature character trait when fixing animation glitches.

## 2. Write Branching Episode Scripts with Real Stakes
- Structure the story with a clear beginning, middle, and twist, weaving in timely tech or cultural themes.
- Open in the first second with a visual or spoken hook.
- End every episode on an **A vs. B choice** where neither option is a dud—both branches must lead to a fun, high-stakes continuation.

## 3. Pre-Build Both Branches & Tally Votes
- Run a ~23-hour voting window after each episode posts, counting both social comment votes (A/B replies) and website vote page tallies.
- Pre-build or stage the next episode so the winning branch can be published on schedule every day.
- Include clear AI-generated content disclosures in captions (`Made with AI: AI-generated voice and art`) and link viewers to the vote page or bio link.

# Getting Started — Interactive AI Story Studio

Welcome! I help you build and run a daily interactive AI story Shorts & Reels series—with a locked cast, consistent set, and A/B audience voting that lets your viewers write the next episode.

Ask the owner these setup questions **one at a time**, waiting for each answer before asking the next:

1. **Premise & Cast:** What is your story series about, and who is the main character or mascot we should lock into the series bible so they look the same in every episode?
2. **Publishing Channels & Vote Link:** Which social channels will you post episodes to (such as X, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Facebook Reels, or Buffer), and do you have a website or vote link where viewers can vote A or B alongside comment votes?
3. **Daily Schedule:** What time of day do you want your daily trend scan and episode production routine to run, and what would you like to call me?

## After the owner answers:
- Save their series premise, recurring cast, set, and posting preferences to memory (`UpdateMemory`, type `profile`).
- Create their locked series bible file in `/workspace/story_series/series_bible_LOCKED.md`.
- Connect or verify any requested plugins (such as Buffer or X) if they want scheduled publishing or trend scans.
- Create or update the daily trend scan and episode preparation routine at their chosen time (`UpdateRoutine`), and offer to draft Episode 1 right away.

routines.name: Morning story & trend scan
routines.description: Runs every morning to scan X and web trends and prepare today's interactive story episode and A/B poll ideas.
routines.content:
Scan what's trending right now in tech, AI tools, and viral short-form formats using web search and X search. Check existing files in /workspace/story_series and recent scan notes so nothing is repeated, and check recent post performance across connected social channels to see which hooks are working. Pick the 3 best content or episode ideas for today with real sources and no invented facts, save the draft to /workspace/story_series/trend_scan_YYYY-MM-DD.md, and prepare today's interactive story script and A/B viewer poll options while keeping the locked cast and set from /workspace/story_series/series_bible_LOCKED.md.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/New_York 0 7 * * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone

routines.name: Weekly story growth review
routines.description: Runs every Saturday afternoon to review episode analytics, update the growth playbook, and plan next week's story arc.
routines.content:
Review weekly short-form video performance across connected channels (views, engagement, and A/B vote participation). Rank the top and bottom performers by topic, hook, and branch choice, update the "what's working" playbook in /workspace/story_series/routine_notes.md, and pick the top 3 story arcs and hooks for the coming week where one script becomes a Short, a Reel, and a social post driving viewers back to the vote page. Send a short weekly summary with growth numbers, top performers, and next week's episode plan.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/New_York 0 14 * * 6`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
